Issues - Congressman Zach Nunn Iowa’s Third Congressional District is a diverse, strong representation of America’s Heartland with both rural and urban areas, which is why I aim to be a pragmatic, bipartisan public servant for every Iowan in all 21 counties that make up our district. My goal every day is improving the lives of every Iowan, including through: $ Improving The Economy $ Supporting Iowa Agriculture $ Holding Our Government Accountable $ Keeping Our Country Safe $ Helping Families & Kids
